headline: Jenny Barzaga Wins Cavite 4th District Special Election with 201,893 Votes
seoTitle: Jenny Barzaga Wins Cavite 4th District Special Election | FMB News
seoDescription: Former Dasmariñas Mayor Jenny Barzaga won the Cavite 4th District special election with 201,893 votes and was proclaimed early August 30.
deck: The former Dasmariñas mayor defeated four other candidates in the special poll, with Comelec reporting a 57.75% voter turnout.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Former Dasmariñas City Mayor Jennifer 'Jenny' Barzaga won the special election for Cavite's 4th Legislative District, receiving 201,893 votes, according to the Commission on Elections results reported by the Philippine News Agency.
The District Board of Canvassers proclaimed Barzaga at 3:30 a.m. Sunday at the City of Dasmariñas Arena after Saturday's special election.

sections.heading: The results
paragraphs: Barzaga finished well ahead of Raul Rex Mangubat, who received 30,361 votes, and Jacinto Frani Jr., who received 24,350. Marvin Dupal-Ag received 1,184 votes and Lysander Ordenes received 561.
Comelec reported 258,361 voters cast ballots out of 447,387 registered voters, equivalent to a 57.75% turnout. Voting hours were extended by two hours because of heavy afternoon rain.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The special election was called after Francisco 'Kiko' Barzaga Jr. was expelled from the House of Representatives in June for disorderly behavior, conduct unbecoming of a member and violations of the House Code of Conduct. Jenny Barzaga is his mother.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The result fills Cavite's 4th District vacancy and restores representation for the district in the House. The election also tested turnout and election administration during severe weather affecting parts of Luzon.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for Barzaga's assumption of office, House committee assignments and the resulting transition in Dasmariñas City leadership.
